title: Remove TanStack Router Devtools from Studio UI
body:
The Studio interface was rendering the TanStack Router Devtools panel on every page, which is a development debug overlay not intended for production/end-user views.

## Changes

- **`apps/studio/src/routes/__root.tsx`** — Removed the `TanStackRouterDevtools` import and its `<TanStackRouterDevtools />` render from `RootComponent`.
